## 📚 Documentation Enhancement

### Context
@copilot please enhance documentation for [component/feature]:

**Documentation Type:**
- [ ] API documentation
- [ ] User guide
- [ ] Developer documentation
- [ ] Bilingual content (Arabic/English)
- [ ] GitBook integration

**Requirements:**
- [ ] Clear explanations with examples
- [ ] Code snippets and API examples
- [ ] Screenshots/diagrams where helpful
- [ ] Arabic translation (RTL support)
- [ ] Mobile-friendly formatting

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Documentation is accurate and up-to-date
- [ ] Examples are working and tested
- [ ] Arabic content follows RTL best practices
- [ ] Content is accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- [ ] GitBook formatting is correct

### Files to Focus On:
- `docs/en/`
- `docs/ar/`
- `README.md`
- API documentation files

### Additional Context
Add any specific requirements or existing documentation that needs updating.
